name: php-code-analyzer
description: Analyze this package's PHP with the tools it already pins: syntax errors, the logical bugs a type checker can see, cyclomatic complexity, PHP 8.4 modernization, duplicate code, and the tool recommendations that follow from what nothing here computes. Commands - analyze, syntax-sweep, analyze-types, analyze-modernize, recommend-tools, analyze-apply. Invoke when a path is being read rather than gated, when an analysis or a complexity or a duplicate question is asked, or when one finding needs fixing through the package's own tools rather than by hand.
author: UAK35
